concerns.text: Verification for T005 only states that CI runs the script and aborts on missing citations, but no explicit test file or assertion is defined. Add a unit/integration test (e.g., `tests/unit/test_pre_run_validation.py`) that invokes the script and checks the exit code for both success and failure cases.

No task addresses Success Criterion SC‑005 (measure total execution time against the 6‑hour GitHub Actions limit). Introduce a task (e.g., T021) that records runtime in `artifacts/runtime_log.json` and includes a test asserting the duration ≤ 6 h.

T010 bundles multiple distinct deliverables (model training, permutation test, bootstrap CI, empirical p‑value computation) into a single task. Split into separate tasks (e.g., T010‑model, T011‑permutation, T012‑bootstrap, T013‑pvalue) to improve granularity and traceability.

T015 combines several diagnostics (permutation importance, FDR correction, VIF calculation, median‑split sweep, α‑sweep, report generation) in one task. Consider atomizing into individual tasks for each diagnostic component to avoid overly coarse specifications.
